title: Jamaican Chicken Skewers
description: Tender chicken marinated in a zesty Jamaican sauce, grilled to perfection on skewers. Serve with a side of Caribbean flair.

ingredients.name: wooden skewers
ingredients.notes: soaked in water for 30 minutes before use

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together jerk seasoning, BBQ sauce, and paprika.
Add the chicken to the marinade and mix until coated.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 2 hours.
Thread the chicken onto the skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Brush the skewers with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Transfer the skewers to a serving platter and garnish with cilantro.
